description: Modbus RTU interface for up to 64 indoor unit groups on a Daikin DIII-net (VRV, Sky Air, hydrobox, ventilation)
source: Daikin, "Design guide Modbus Interface DIII EKMBDXB7V1", 4P642495-1A (2022.02)

sources.title: Design guide Modbus Interface DIII EKMBDXB7V1
sources.note: chapter 2 (communication) and chapter 3 (input and holding registers)

notes: Each DIII address 1-00 to 4-15 has its own block of registers; index n runs from 0 (1-00) to 63 (4-15) and the register groups are named after the DIII address.
Communication: DS1-2 off = 9600, on = 19200 baud; DS1-3/DS1-4 select parity even 1 stop (default), odd 1 stop, none 2 stop or none 1 stop. The slave address (1-15) is set with DS2.
Supported function codes: 03, 04, 06 and 16. At most 32 registers per read and 30 per write.

Holding registers do not follow the real state of the units: they only take the actual values when a unit is detected. Before changing one field, copy the current values from the matching input registers into the holding register so the other fields are not changed.
Which registers have a meaning depends on the unit type (indoor unit, ventilation, hydrobox); check the capability registers first.
The set point range bytes are 8-bit signed values in °C; they are read here as unsigned bytes, so values above 127 are negative (value - 256).
